spots.name: Strawberry Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,754 m (9,036 ft).

spots.name: Monument Rock Wilderness

spots.name: Strawberry Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Mason Dam Viewpoint
